description.value: Pho Goodness is a Vietnamese comfort-food chain established in 2011, with this Main & 26th outpost operating as a takeout-only counter in Vancouver's Mount Pleasant neighbourhood. The menu centres on pho, banh mi, rice dishes, and vermicelli bowls in a quick-service format with online pre-ordering to minimize wait times. The chain has been named best Vietnamese and best pho in Westender Magazine's 'Best of City' awards multiple times.
